propositions: Bridge cron backstop schedule must be halved from 20-minute to 40-minute uniform cadence using three cron entries over a 2-hour cycle with uniformly-spaced 40-minute gaps
Chain re-dispatch step must sleep for the pass's own elapsed duration before dispatching, capped at 900 seconds and skipped if elapsed exceeds 1800 seconds or PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is unset
Canary poll schedule must be halved from hourly to 2-hourly and its staleness alert window must be doubled from 2 hours to 4 hours
Jenkinsfile backstop must mirror the three-entry 40-minute cycle identical to GitHub workflows
All documentation, comments, and alert messages referencing the old */20 cadence or hourly canary must be updated to reflect new 40-minute and 2-hourly values
Tests must assert fire-time uniformity of cron entries, validate pacing sleep branches, and verify backward compatibility when PASS_STARTED_EPOCH is absent
